title: The Secret in the Snow — family memory, discovery and lookalike

characters.description: Elderly silver-muzzled Bernese, burgundy collar, grandmother
Adult male Bernese, navy collar, grandson
Adult female Bernese, green collar, wife
Same face as Bruno, faded brown collar, in toolshed

facts.description: The accepted introduction establishes family and ends with Penny’s cheese joke.
Grandmother and grandson remember his twin differently.
Heidi investigates, doubts herself and calls family for help.
Audience alone sees a dog resembling Bruno.
One unresolved question closes the short.
Sebastian is Bruno’s absent brother; grandmother remembers his breakfast trick.
Bruno believes Sebastian died after the kennel fire.
Bruno’s discomfort comes from missing Sebastian.
Heidi notices a scent while remembering her grandson.
The scent comes from the adjacent grooming room.
Heidi calls Bruno to inspect what she found.
Heidi believes the fur smells like Sebastian.
Heidi asks others to investigate rather than treating her suspicion as proof.
Bruno believes nobody survived the kennel fire.
A brown-collared dog resembling Bruno sits outside.
Navy-collared Bruno remains inside; the outside dog is someone else.

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: Grandmother? Come back in. Penny's negotiating for your breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: My twin got the looks. I got the sausage.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: Your brother Sebastian did that too. He'd steal breakfast without leaving his bed.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: You were supposed to share it.

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: We did.

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: Then the kennel burned down.

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: He's dead, Grandmother. You can't spend every morning waiting.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: They never found him.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: You're allowed to miss him, Bruno.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: Wait. That smell...

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: I do. That's why I can't keep looking at that.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: From the grooming room.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: He used to hide in here. As if I couldn't smell him.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: Fresh fur.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: No... I'm imagining it.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: Bruno. Come and smell this.

dialogue.speaker: sadie
dialogue.text: We heard you. Um, what's happened?

dialogue.speaker: sadie
dialogue.text: You really think he's been here?

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: This smells like Sebastian.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: I thought that too. Then I smelled it again.

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: We all shed, Grandmother. It's probably mine.

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: I wish it were him. I do.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: I don't know. I... I need you to look.

dialogue.speaker: heidi
dialogue.text: Then whose scent is this?

dialogue.speaker: bruno
dialogue.text: But nobody survived that fire.
